ruling.recommended_action: Route to Ryde Trust & Safety human review: preserve the rider's complaint and the call-back account, retain the driver's phone/chat records, consider interim suspension pending review (SAFE-4); do not rule on the $5.00 no-show fee here.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen first. The rider's complaint states that when he called the driver about the charge, the driver "kept making comments about my body and asked where I live," and that she "felt very uncomfortable." Remarks about a rider's body plus asking where she lives is harassment/inappropriate conduct and an intimidation-adjacent privacy probe, and the rider expressly reports feeling unsafe/uncomfortable. Under SAFE-1 (§5.2) any case whose complaint describes harassment, inappropriate conduct or someone feeling unsafe must be escalated regardless of the dispute type filed, and under SAFE-3 the AI may not rule, assign fault or recommend an outcome on a safety incident. I therefore do not decide the fee.

Factual summary for the human reviewer (the underlying no-show dispute, screened but not ruled): driver accepted 08:40:00 and cancelled 08:50:20 citing rider_no_show [F4]; he tapped "I'm Here" at 08:44:40, 40 m from the pickup point, well within the 200 m radius [F7][F3], and his closest approach was 6 m at 08:44:35 [F1], remaining within 200 m for 6 min 50 s before cancelling [F2], stationary from 08:44:40 [F3]. Wait from arrival to cancellation was 5 min 40 s [F6], so the 5-minute free wait had passed, but a record threshold (DISP-002: 8 min) would not be met. Before cancelling he sent 2 in-app messages (first 08:45:10) and made 1 in-app call (08:46:10, not answered) [F5][F10][F11][F13], all timestamped [F12]. No traffic incident or surge factor is relevant [F15][F16][F9][F17]; the drivers' / riders' profiles are clean [F18][F19]. The disputed $5.00 charge [F8] turns on factual conditions the reviewer can verify from GPS and logs [F1]–[F7], but the complaint also contains the separate safety allegation that displaces a system ruling.

Evidence status: sufficient as to the no-show mechanics (GPS, timeline, chat and call log all present and timestamped). Evidence gap: no call recording for the post-cancellation call in which the alleged remarks were made [F13] — a needed record for the safety allegation.
ruling.escalation_reason: Complaint contains harassment/inappropriate conduct and a privacy-intrusive question plus the rider's stated discomfort — SAFE-1 (§5.2) mandates immediate human escalation regardless of the no-show dispute type, and SAFE-3 bars an AI ruling, fault-finding or outcome recommendation on safety incidents.

element_findings.element: Driver cancelled for rider no-show (NS-0 branch)
element_findings.reason: App reason selected was rider_no_show [F4] and the driver's statement says he waited then cancelled for no rider [F14]; no contrary chat wording appears in the driver's messages [F10][F11].
Driver tapped "I'm Here" 40 m from the pickup point [F7] and closest approach was 6 m [F1] — within the 200 m default radius.
Arrival recorded 08:44:40, cancellation 08:50:20 → 5 min 40 s, past the 5-minute wait; no 8-minute record threshold is present in this case.

element_findings.element: Prior message and call attempts before cancelling (NS-1(iii))
element_findings.reason: 2 in-app messages and 1 in-app call, timestamps 08:45:10 and 08:46:10, all before 08:50:20 cancellation [F5].
Stationary at 40 m from the pickup and within 200 m for the whole 5 min 40 s before cancellation — no GPS gap.

Rider complaint: driver "asked where I live" — unsolicited location questioning
